content: Kikau kikolongu sa banafunzi ku Yelusalemu
Bandu bangi bahika ku Antiokia kuhuma ku Yudea nuku tumbulili kwaabola bandu babunzetaki Sapanga bala kupwaga, “Ana ngakuseku jandu ngati hejutulagalakia Musa, nganhwesi kukombulewa.”

Pauli na Balunaba ngase bajetaki mabole gabo ndi kwapitila kujobane nukulalukani na bandu bala, ndi baamua Pauli na Balunaba na bandu bangi kati jabu ajenda ku Yelusalemu ili kulilongale lijambu heli naka atumi baka Yesu bangi pamu na Aseja.
Ndienu bandu baanhobale Kilisitu batenda kwaatabuka, pabapetila ku Foinike nuku Samalia baalandila bandu amanya bandu banga Ayaudi bunng'anambuki Sapanga. Bandu bala hebajogwa batoguli ngamaa.
Pabahika ku Yelusalemu bandu ba bunhobale Sapanga, atumi baka Yesu naka aseja batenda kwaajopa nabombi baalandila goka gajwatenda Sapanga pamu nabombi.
Ila pe bandu bangi ba bunhobale Kilisitu bikikundi saka Afalisayu bajema nukupwaga, “Kupalika bandu banga kuba Ayaudi asekula jandu nakaabola namuna jukupwata Malagalaki gaka Musa.”
Henu, atumi baka Yesu na aseja batenda kikau kikolongu ili amanya sukutenda.

Balongila muda nndasu, Petili jaamua kujema nukupwaga, “Mwalongubangu, mwabe mmanya toka masoba gukutumbuli Sapanga jwanhagula nepani nkati jitu nandila Lijambu la Amboni kwaka bandu bandema yengi, ili ajowana nukuhobale.
Najombi Sapanga jojumanya mioju jitu, jwalangi jwaapai sakaapeke nabombi Loho jaka Sapanga ngati hejutupeki twepani.
Sapanga ngasejutubagwi kati jitu na bombi, jaalekakia mahakau gabu ndaba batenda kusapisa mioju jabu kukuhobale kwabu.
Henu, ndaba jaki kunndenga Sapanga sakaatweka bandu haba nsigu goguwe hata aka hoku bitu wala twabe ngasetwawesiki kutoto.
Kwiikuba hela, ila tuhobale, ana twepani tubii ngati bombi, twigombuliwa kupete waamboni waka Bambu Yesu.”
Bandu boka batama nuu, baamua kwajoane Balunaba na Pauli hebalandila ndonduke na nginyuli yejwatenda Sapanga kupete maboku gabu kwa bandu banga Ayaudi.
Pabajomula kulonge, Yakobu japwaga, “Mwaalongu bangu, nyowannya nepani!
Simoni julandi namuna Sapanga mumasoba gumunyuma hejwaatendila bandu bandema yengi, jaagula bandu bangi akuba bandu baki.
Lijambu heli lilengana na malobi gaka alota baka Sapanga, ngati Maandiku gaka Sapanga hegapwaga.”

content.text: nukusenga kabee nyumba jaka Daudi jejiabwiki,
ili bandu baaigili boti bumpala Bambu,
na bandu bandema yoti banaakemiki abia bangu, bampala Bambu.
Ndi hejupwaga Sapanga, jojwatenda lijambu heli limanyikana toka mwandi.”

content: Yakobo jaendaliya kupwaaga, “Henu, senhamwi ne senze, tukoto kwaasumbuu bandu bandema jengi babung'anambuki Sapanga,
ila Pee twaalembila balua kwaapwagi biikula poso jejibii mbija jeatambiki mahoka, akotuka usalati, biikula kinyama sebikinyongiki, kabee bikula mwai.
Ndaba masoba gingi malobi gaka Musa gabi galandika kila musi nukugasoma mu nyumba jukuketangane Ayaudi yoka kila Lisoba lu Kupomulela.”
Balua kwaka bandu babuhole banga Ayaudi

Atumi baka Yesu, aseja na bandu boka ba bunhobale Sapanga baamua kwaagu bandu nkati jabu nakaapwagi ajenda ku Antiokia pamu na Pauli na Balunaba. Henu, bunhagula Yuda jobunkema kabee Balusaba na Sila babaii akakilongosi ba bandu babahobali Sapanga.

Baapekia balua jejiandiki ana, “Jambuoti, twepani twaka atumi baka Yesu na aseja na alongu binu na tutenda kunhandi balua mwabandu banga Ayaudi mwanganya mwembi ku Antiokia hoku, ku Silia nuku Kilikia.
Tujowini bandu bangi babahuma koni batenda kunsumbu kwa malobi gabu, nukujibeka mioju jabu jibii nulujogopu. Twepani ngase twaalagalaki kutenda hela.
Henu, tuamwi pamu kwaagu bandu baakumu nakaapwagi ahika kwinu pamu na akosi bitu Balunaba na Pauli,
bandu bababii tayali hata kuwa ndaba ji liina laka Bambu witu Yesu Kilisitu.
Henu twaapwagi Yuda na Sila ahika hoku, kumpwagi mwanganya kupetee milomu jabu malobi gatunhandaki mu balua.
Ndienu, Loho jaka Sapanga jutupwaagi tukotoka kuntweka mwanganya nsigu ila pe majambu ganga gagapalika:
Mwikula posu jeatambaki mahoka, mwikula wala mwiikunywa mwai na mwikula inyama jikinyama seakinyongiki nzepana usalati. Mwibia ntei sapi ana nkotwiki kutenda haga. Kwaheli!”
Pabajomula kwaatabuka bandu bala, bajenda ku Antiokia kokuje bakema kikau saka bandu babuhobale Kilisitu, nakaapeke balua jela.
Pabasoma balua jela, malobi gaki gaatenda agangamala mwoju, batoguli ngamaa.
Yuda na Sila, bababi kabee alota, balongila na bandu ba bunhobali Kilisitu bala kwa malobi gingi tulisa mwoju na kwaasenga.
Baada jukutama kola kwa muda, bandu ba bunhobali Kilisitu buku Antiokia baatabuka koni baalobe lukwali, ndi babuja kwa babatumiki.
Sila jaamua kuigali.
Pauli na Balunaba baigalia ku Antiokia kwa muda, baabola bandu nukulandi Lilobi laka Bambu, pamu na bandu bangi bingi.
Pauli na Balunaba atenda kulekana
Pagapeta masoba kidogu, Pauli ampwagila Balunaba, “Tubuja twakaalinga bandu bala kila musi kotwaalandila lilobi laka Bambo, tukilibonila twabe eandalela.”
Balunaba japala bunzukua na Yohana jobunkema kabee Maluko.
Lakini Pauli ngase jabona sapi kujenda na Maluko, jojaaleka ku Pamfilia nukukana kuhenga lihengu pamu nabu.
Ndienu, wapitali ubisi nkolongu, ngase bajetangini, baamua kulekana. Balunaba anzukua Maluko, bakwela sitima bajenda ku Kupulo.
Najombi Pauli anhagula Sila, baada ja bandu ba pala kundobe uamboni waka Sapanga, batenda kuboka.
Hebabia atenda kujenda bapetila ku Silia nuku Kilikia, koni jaasenga bandu ba bunhobale Kilisitu kupete malobi gaki.
